_comment: Credentials manifest for scraped sources currently deferred/blocked on api_key or token. Generated from tasks/datasets_to_scrap.md's Deferred/Excluded sections on 2026-07-10. Fill in `env_var` values in your shell/secrets manager, not in this file — this file only tracks WHICH keys are needed and WHERE to get them, never the key values themselves.

credentials.notes: One free key covers all api.portaldatransparencia.gov.br endpoints — highest priority to register since it unblocks 7 pipelines at once, all currently sitting in datasets_to_scrap.md's Deferred section.

For a live query-on-demand tool in mcp_server.py, NOT a bulk mirror — CNJ Res. 331/2020 & 446/2022 forbid bulk redistribution. Verify current registration process on the wiki before assuming standard self-serve signup; some DataJud docs reference a shared public read key rather than per-user registration, unconfirmed as of 2026-07-10.

EXCLUDED, not just deferred — source is CC BY-ND 3.0, which forbids derivative works. Don't register this key or build against it; listed here only for completeness so nobody re-derives the same dead end.

Requires a Meta developer account plus identity verification for political/social-issue ad access. Low priority — per 2026 Meta ToS changes, ad coverage for Brazil may already be degraded/unavailable regardless of credentials.
Free tier available. Low priority — general finance data, not corruption-relevant, and it's an unofficial third-party wrapper rather than official B3 data.
